description: Source code for a Drupal Views argument plugin class 'UserUid' that handles user ID arguments for comments, enabling filtering and sorting of comments by user.

classes.name: UserUid
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for handling user ID arguments in views, specifically for comments, allowing filtering and sorting based on user.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the plugin with configuration, plugin ID, definition, and database connection.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Returns the display title for the argument, fetching the username or default label if no argument is provided.

methods.name: defaultActions
methods.description: Defines default actions for the argument, disallowing summary views.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds the database query to filter comments by user ID, using subselects and conditions.

methods.name: getSortName
methods.description: Returns the name used for sorting, labeled 'Numerical'.
